_about: The alert's non-personal copy. No names live here. The pipeline (alert/pipeline.py) fills {SITE_URL} and {PRIVACY_URL} from settings, joins each person's opener with alert_block and privacy_line into custom_message_1 before import, and leaves {{first_name}} for GetSales to render. Draft until Alex ticks the pre-send gate. Constraints from the research on delivery, reception and personal data: note under 200 characters, one short retypeable link, the right to object in its own sentence, a job application rather than a pitch (no freelance, services, offer, book a call), AI use said plainly by Alex himself, and no promise of what the site shows tonight.
note_with_link: Hi {{first_name}}, I'm applying to work with Addvery via a 12-hour live build today. Follow along: {SITE_URL} (privacy note there). Rather not? Ignore this, I won't follow up. Alex
note_without_link: Hi {{first_name}}, I'm applying to work with Addvery via a 12-hour live build today, and you're welcome to follow along. Rather not? Ignore this, I won't follow up. Alex
alert_block: I'm applying to Addvery as a GTM engineer, and my application is a 12-hour build on Monday 2 November, live and recorded: the research and outbound systems I'd run if I joined. You'll find it at {SITE_URL}
privacy_line:
Why you're getting this, and what I keep about you: {PRIVACY_URL}
If you'd rather I stopped, reply "no" and I'll delete what I hold and not write again.
msg2_why: A word on why I'm applying this way. My background is B2B marketing, and the work I want now is GTM engineering: building the systems that find the right accounts, research them and start the right conversations. A CV can only claim that, so I built them in the open instead. AI agents did most of the building, under my direction, including the research behind my first message to you. Deciding what to build, and checking it, was my part. It's all at {SITE_URL}
msg3_close: Last note from me on this. If the build makes a case for me, I'd value 20 minutes whenever suits you, to hear where I might fit at Addvery or what you'd have done differently. If not, no reply needed, and I won't follow up. Alex
